name: Tolmere
description: A mountain city of grey stone and shaven-headed monks, which the Red Fleet has chosen this morning to take.

gate.name: The Gate of Tolmere
gate.description: Two grey towers and a gate that has been broken inward. Smoke lies in the streets beyond, and under it the sound of fists, and of men who are not enjoying it.

courtyard.name: The Courtyard
courtyard.description: A wide square of dressed stone before the great hall. Monks and soldiers in red are all through it, locked together, and the hall doors stand open.

hall.name: The Great Hall
hall.description: A bare hall of grey pillars, hung with nothing, built for men who needed nothing. At the far end a plain stone chair, and a door behind it.

crystal_room.name: The Crystal Room
crystal_room.description: A small round chamber where a pale crystal on a stone stand fills the room with a light like early morning. Fresh scorch marks cover the floor.

rampart.name: The Rampart
rampart.description: A wall-walk above the courtyard with a view of the whole mountain and the dark shapes of Red Fleet airships wheeling over it.

harbor.name: The Quay
harbor.description: A stone quay below the city, where Tolmere's fishing boats lie smashed against their moorings and one grey sloop, miraculously whole, rides at the end.

east.failure_message: The open sea is no place to walk. You will need a ship.
